scripts.xorshift32_step:
def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    X = int(inputs['X']) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    A = int(inputs['A'])
    B = int(inputs['B'])
    C = int(inputs['C'])
    K = int(inputs['K'])
    for _ in range(K):
        X ^= ((X << A) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        X ^= (X >> B)
        X ^= ((X << C) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        X &= 0xFFFFFFFF
    return float(X)
